text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate is not allowed. If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is not present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate must be present.
reading: InterbankSettlementDate is in the GroupHeader or in every DirectDebitTransactionInformation, not both
